title: Constrained Delta Evolution (CDE): A General Framework for Structural Search, Optimization, Metric Evolution, and Distributed Intelligence
description:
Constrained Delta Evolution (CDE) is a proposed specifications-first research framework for exploring state spaces through generated deltas governed by explicit constraints, evaluation policies, and path semantics. It generalizes ideas from Bucket Tree of Permutation (BTP) and Dynamic Bucket Tree of Permutation (D-BTP) into a state–delta–constraint approach supporting adaptive M-to-N branching, path memory and loop control, multi-scale directional exploration, and integration with established search, dynamic programming, and branch-and-bound methods.

The v1.0.0 research corpus includes 12 foundations papers, six specifications, five illustrative cases, four research extensions, and accompanying glossaries, open questions, testable hypotheses, and a validation roadmap. It also examines solution–metric co-evolution, distributed exploration, typed structural relay, collective learning, and controlled recursive generator evolution. This release presents theoretical proposals and research protocols, not empirical demonstrations of superior performance, generalization, or recursive self-improvement. Such claims require independent, reproducible validation.
